text: Three in the afternoon, in Pune. Outside these hospitals and schools, people wait on footpaths in full sun. Cities have money for trees and shade, but no quick way to decide where it helps most.

EcoZone AI maps where heat, missing afternoon shade and waiting people overlap. Shade comes from building geometry at one, three and four pm. Across Deccan Gymkhana, footpath shade is just 17 out of 100.
A planner sets a budget of 10 lakh rupees. At least 30 percent must help this summer, not only trees that take years.

Gemini proposes whole plans. Our engine, not the model, scores every one, for shade, heat, green and ventilation. It keeps tree rows off deep, narrow lanes, where they would block the breeze. A greedy baseline always runs alongside.

In this run, the simple baseline scored higher, and the app says so. Its plan lifts the area cooling score from 30 to 35 for 10 lakh rupees, passes the ventilation check, and shades 2 waiting points. The mix: 34 street tree rows, 2 cool roof blocks and 1 depave and plant site.
Here is that street at 3 pm, today and with the plan. Once the new trees grow, this footpath by a waiting point is in shade.
Accept the plan, and it exports as a printable brief: the work phased by season, with field checks for every site.
Protect asks the next question: will a new building undo this? Here is a vacant plot of 3,988 square metres, on an 8 metre street.
A developer proposes 15 floors on 60 percent of the plot. Scores update live. The risk label is high: ventilation on the parcel's own block falls by 41 points.

Gemini searches for better designs, and the engine scores each one. Option B keeps 83 percent of the floor area and cuts the worst change to 20. Option C keeps 40 percent and cuts it to 18. The app shows the risk. The planner decides.

Every number here comes from one deterministic engine. Gemini proposes and explains, but never computes a score. We report what we measured: over four budgets, live Gemini beat the greedy baseline once and lost three times. Our heat index agrees only weakly with Landsat surface temperature on held-out blocks, and that is not significant. EcoZone AI: repair and protect a city's cooling network.
